name: CC0Tree — free low-poly game assets (CC0)
summary: Public-domain library of gradient-shaded low-poly, game-ready 3D props (tools, weapons props, electronics, garden, trees, misc) by SkyWolf Game Studios, at real-world scale, with new models weekly. Just launched on the Godot Asset Store; latest drop is an ammo box and bullet. Every FBX downloads free from GitHub; .blend sources and packaged zip are Patreon perks.

access.price: $0; .blend sources + packaged FBX zip for Patreon/itch supporters
access.notes: No attribution required. Small one-person library, repo has ~5 stars.

procedure: Open the CC0Tree site and browse the library, or open the GitHub repo.
Download individual FBX files from 'All Models/<category>/', or grab the whole repo zip (~15 MB).
Godot users can also install it from the Godot Asset Store listing.

stats.count: ~35 models (66 FBX files across All/New/Updated folders)

verdict.why: Genuine CC0 low-poly props with direct no-signup downloads and weekly cadence, new Godot Asset Store launch. Small library and low visibility so far.

image.alt: Low-poly green ammo box with three yellow bullets on a black background
